worldcombat.skill.heavyslam.summary: Drop your whole body from above: the more you outweigh the target, the harder it lands. The ground marks the planned landing first, but the real impact follows where the body actually comes down, and a low ceiling cuts the arc short. The landing shock scatters everyone around and settles damage on each by its own weight. The sinking form is tighter and heavier; the pouncing form leaps further and shoves wider.
worldcombat.skill.heavyslam.use.0: Crush a lighter target under your weight
worldcombat.skill.heavyslam.use.1: Scatter a cluster of foes on landing
worldcombat.skill.heavyslam.use.2: Slam down onto a chosen landing point
The slam settles one hit of about %1$s contact damage on every enemy within a %2$s block landing radius, each computed from its own weight ratio against you; the more you outweigh the target the harder it hits, and a target that takes the hit is also shoved.
Leap from up to %1$s blocks away, %2$s blocks high with %3$s seconds of air time, and shove targets in the landing area %4$s blocks; the planned landing is marked on the ground at take-off.
worldcombat.skill.heavyslam.landing: The mark is only a prediction: the hit settles wherever the body actually lands. A low ceiling ends the rise early and shortens the arc, so it never bursts at the far end it failed to reach; landing against a wall only hits the near side, and no ground is replaced.
worldcombat.skill.heavyslam.anchor.on: Sinking form: a shorter, heavier, tighter slam, at the cost of less shove and a longer recovery and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.heavyslam.anchor.off: Pouncing form: a longer leap that shoves wider, but lighter and quicker.
worldcombat.skill.heavyslam.timing: Leap from within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.heavyslam.growth.0: At level %1$s, the slam power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.heavyslam.growth.1: At level %1$s, the slam power rises to %2$s and the landing radius to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.heavyslam.preference.a: On: a shorter leap with more single-target power and a tighter landing, but less shove and a longer recovery and cooldown. Off: a pouncing form that leaps further and shoves wider, but hits lighter.
Only leap once a foe is within this distance. Larger values pounce from further away and are easier to dodge during the air time.
On: prefer the slam when two or more foes cluster around the target (one landing covers them all). Off: choose purely by weight ratio.
It only opens with Heavy Slam when its own weight is at least this many times the target's; 0 means always. Raise it to slam only when clearly heavier.
